items.t: Head gasket leaks
items.note: Usually includes head machining and a timing belt kit. Cost rises a lot if the engine overheated.

items.t: AWD binding in tight turns (automatic)
items.job: Replace AWD transfer clutch (duty C) solenoid
items.note: Match all four tires first. If the transfer clutch pack itself is worn, expect much more.

items.t: Catalytic converter failure (P0420)
items.note: Low end is an aftermarket converter. States with strict emissions rules require costlier approved units.

items.t: Brake lines can rust through (recall)
items.job: Replace rusted rear brake lines and bleed brakes
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall for affected years. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Secondary air pump can stay on and overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace secondary air pump and relay
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: CVT cooler hose can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace CVT cooler hose and refill fluid
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall. Check your VIN. If the CVT was run low on fluid, it may need replacing.

items.t: CVT shudder, jerking, or stalling
items.job: Reprogram CVT computer and change CVT fluid
items.note: Subaru extended CVT coverage on many cars; ask the dealer with your VIN. A valve body or new CVT costs much more.

items.t: Wiper motor cover can overheat and melt (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Electronic parking brake may not hold (manual transmission, recall)
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.note: Subaru extended coverage after an oil use test; ask a dealer with your VIN. Many owners just top off the oil.

items.t: Steering column shafts may separate (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Battery drains while parked
items.job: Replace battery and update module software
items.note: A class settlement covered some battery costs; ask a dealer. Finding a separate parasitic drain adds diagnosis time.

items.t: Windshield cracks with no clear impact
items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate EyeSight cameras
items.note: A class settlement extended windshield coverage on some years; ask a dealer. Glass may be covered by insurance.

items.t: Touchscreen radio freezes or glitches
items.note: If the head unit itself must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Transmission oil can leak onto exhaust (recall)
items.job: Repair transmission oil leak and top up fluid
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Steering column may be machined wrong (do-not-drive recall)
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall. Check your VIN right away or ask the dealer.

items.t: Low-fuel warning light may not come on (recall)
items.note: Software fix done free under a Subaru recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Low-pressure fuel pump may fail (recall)
items.note: Covered by the Denso fuel pump recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: CVT drive chain can slip and break (recall)
items.note: Done under a Subaru recall; check your VIN. If the chain already failed, the CVT is replaced under the recall.

items.t: Brake pedal bracket bolt may be loose or missing (recall)
items.job: Inspect and install brake pedal bracket bolt
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Rearview camera image may drop out (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall; some cars get a new module. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Thermo control valve fault
items.note: Subaru released an updated valve. Ask the dealer if your car is still under powertrain warranty.

items.t: Passenger occupant sensor may shut off airbag (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Large touchscreen freezes, blanks or reboots
items.note: If the head unit itself must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Gear selector cable nut may loosen (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten shift cable nut
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Water in inhibitor switch disables reverse lights and camera (recall)
items.note: Covered by a Subaru recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.
